title: Pivotality of the dual parity function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, and choose a coordinate $i$. The Boolean dual of the parity function on all $n$ coordinates takes different values at $x$ and at the vector obtained by flipping coordinate $i$ of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign vector x of length n
